evaluations.reason: We walk by faith, not by sight; the walk enacts faith.
Walk by the Spirit and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh; the walk enacts the Spirit's leading.
Walk in love, as Christ loved us; the walk enacts love.
This is love, that we walk according to his commandments; the walk is the enactment of love.
The second walk of the same verse, walk in it, read with it.
Walk in wisdom toward outsiders; the walk enacts wisdom.
Look carefully how you walk, not as unwise but as wise; the walk enacts wisdom.
Walk no longer as the Gentiles do, in the futility of their minds; the walk enacts the mind state.
Walk before me with integrity of heart and uprightness; the walk enacts the heart's integrity.
A shield to those who walk in integrity; the walk enacts integrity.
They rest in their beds who walk in their uprightness; the walk enacts uprightness.
The daughters of Zion are haughty and walk with outstretched necks; the walk enacts the haughty heart.
Walk in the ways of your heart; the walk enacts what the heart directs.
Though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart; the walk enacts the stubborn heart.
